name: Lilybelle Lemonade
description: Lilybelle Lemonade is an artist working across creative direction, film costuming and visual art: collage, photography, sculpture and painting.
bio: I’m an artist and creative director. My work covers commercial creative direction and styling, costume for film, collage, photography, sculpture and painting. I costumed Thea Goes to Town (2021), Syb & the Myth (2022) and Dummy (2025).
